obligations.text: statecraft-home parses YAML only through spec_spine_core::types::yaml and depends on no other YAML parser.
Every structural verdict the two readers reached under serde_yaml (workflow_call present, jobs nonempty, a needs entry naming a job) is unchanged for every workflow those specs' tests read.
The existing setup and external-code suites pass unchanged in their assertions, and a parity test reads each fixture workflow through the new reader with the verdicts the old one gave.

sectionHeadings: 045: statecraft-home reads YAML through the adopted producer's one reader
record.summary: Amends specs 002, 012 and 032 so every YAML document statecraft-home parses (a project's reusable code workflow, and the default branch's CI workflow the remote-state comparison reads) is read by spec-spine's one YAML reader, which this product already links, and removes the direct serde_yaml dependency. The workspace then carries no unsafe-libyaml, and RUSTSEC-2024-0449 no longer applies here.
record.title: statecraft-home reads YAML through the adopted producer's one reader
